description: This PHP source file defines the TimeReportDataAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time module API namespace. It extends a base report data API class and provides a method to retrieve specific time report data, including detailed API documentation through annotations. The class uses external report classes and exception handling to manage API responses for time report data retrieval.

classes.name: TimeReportDataAPI
classes.description: Provides an API for retrieving time report data, supporting various parameters and handling report type validation.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the specific report object based on the report name parameter, throwing an exception if the report name is invalid.
